runners_data.name: Risk De Cerisy
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with unknown running style but Skelton's strong yard form and the pull-up last time makes her hard to assess

runners_data.name: Eremenko
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to the expected modest pace and has proven form on similar going with Henderson's 20% strike rate

runners_data.name: Pigeon Forge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose recent form shows consistency but may lack the quality edge at this level despite suitable conditions

runners_data.name: Approaching Storm
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with a tendency to fade in the finish makes her vulnerable even if getting the right pace setup

races.paceDynamic: That Is Blue will look to take the field along from the front with Pigeon Forge likely to sit prominent, creating a sustainable but not pressurized early gallop in this small field of five. The modest pace will allow the hold-up horses Eremenko and Approaching Storm to get into contention turning for home, while Risk De Cerisy's running style remains uncertain but she's unlikely to apply early pressure. With no genuine speed in the field and plenty of stamina required over 2m4½f at Plumpton, this race shape strongly favours patient, finishing types who can quicken late rather than those needing a strong pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest with That Is Blue and Pigeon Forge content to go steadily
scenarios.body: Eremenko and any other closers will have every chance to pick up the pieces late when the early leaders tire over this stamina test. The quality gap between Eremenko (OR 120) and the front-runners becomes decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If That Is Blue gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: The mare can dictate terms throughout and prove hard to pass, especially if the hold-up horses don't get the strong pace they need. Her prominent style suits Plumpton's configuration well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Pigeon Forge travels better than That Is Blue and can improve on recent efforts
scenarios.body: She can get first run on the leader and hold off late challengers, benefiting from a perfect position just off the pace. Her similar rating to That Is Blue makes this a live possibility.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Risk De Cerisy shows significant improvement from her Skelton yard after the pull-up
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced mare could have untapped ability and benefit from any pace scenario given her unknown running style. Skelton's 22% strike rate provides some trainer confidence.

watchPoints.text: Eremenko's jumping under pressure - any mistake late could cost her when she's travelling best
That Is Blue's fitness levels after 66 days off, particularly in the final half-mile where stamina becomes crucial
Risk De Cerisy's early positioning to gauge her running style and whether she has the ability to match her rating
The pace through the middle section - if it stays too steady the hold-up horses get a significant advantage
Pigeon Forge's jumping rhythm as any errors could derail her chances of capitalizing on her handy position

runners_data.name: Ballyfinn
runners_data.note: Front-running style gives him tactical advantage but 18-day break and poor recent form are concerns against this quality.

runners_data.name: Sweet Nightingale
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent winning form but needs luck in running from off the pace in small field.

runners_data.name: Delgany Deadline
runners_data.note: Class hold-up performer from strong Skelton yard but 40-day absence and needs race to develop for late charge.

runners_data.name: Milan Milos
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with significant weight advantage but trainer form is poor and hasn't won for long time.

races.paceDynamic: Ballyfinn will set the pace from the front with no genuine speed to pressure him early in this small field. Sweet Nightingale, Delgany Deadline and Milan Milos all prefer to be held up, creating a tactical race where the leader can dictate terms. The lack of early pace pressure means Ballyfinn can control fractions and kick clear, while the three hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will affect the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ballyfinn Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyfinn gets an easy lead and steady fractions over 3m1½f
scenarios.body: He can kick clear turning for home while the three hold-up horses struggle to make up the deficit from their patient positions. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly despite the slow pace
scenarios.body: Delgany Deadline or Sweet Nightingale produce strong late kicks to reel in Ballyfinn who may have gone too slow early. The class and recent form of these two gives them the finishing power needed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ballyfinn Fades Late
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyfinn's 18-day break and recent poor form catches up with him in the final furlong
scenarios.body: His early advantage gets whittled away by the stronger-finishing hold-up horses who benefit from the honest gallop. Sweet Nightingale's recent win gives her the confidence to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Milan Milos Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Milan Milos gets a perfect trip through the pack and benefits from the weight concession
scenarios.body: His 12lb weight advantage over Ballyfinn becomes decisive in the closing stages as the pace collapses. The longer absence works in his favour with freshness.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Ballyfinn gets pressured early as his recent form suggests vulnerability when not allowed easy lead.
Watch for traffic problems affecting Sweet Nightingale and Delgany Deadline if they get boxed in behind slow pace.
Watch Milan Milos for signs of freshness returning after 23-day break given his previous decent form.
Watch for jockey inexperience affecting the race as Callum Pritchard only has 3 rides recently.
Watch the pace through halfway as Ballyfinn's ability to quicken depends on conserving energy early.

races.paceDynamic: Shalfa is the only natural front runner and will get an easy lead with Definite and Voix De Bocelli racing prominently behind. The large hold-up contingent of Goodwin Face, Pottersmattyeeehaa, Dream's Ka, Ballybay, Arenas Del Tiempo and Major Major will sit off the sustainable pace. With no pace pressure on Shalfa, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to produce their finishing kicks. This tactical scenario strongly favours horses that can close from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Shalfa sets a pedestrian pace unchallenged through the early stages
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade will have plenty left in the tank for strong finishing efforts over the final two furlongs. Goodwin Face and Pottersmattyeeehaa have the class and recent form to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Shalfa exploits easy lead
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner can dictate fractions without any early pressure from the prominent racers
scenarios.body: Shalfa will have conserved energy in front and can kick clear before the hold-up horses get organised. The lack of pace pressure plays directly into the leader's hands.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent racers take over
scenarios.trigger: If Voix De Bocelli or Definite decide to press Shalfa earlier than expected
scenarios.body: This creates a more genuine gallop that suits the prominent racers who can pick up the pieces when the leader weakens. Voix De Bocelli has good recent placed form to capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make the running and the field crawls through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where tactical position matters more than stamina. Any horse finding the rail or getting first run can steal this.

watchPoints.text: Shalfa could steal this if allowed to dictate completely uncontested fractions from the front
Watch for any early pressure on Shalfa from Voix De Bocelli or Definite as this changes the entire race dynamic
Goodwin Face needs to be positioned handy turning in to utilise his strong finishing kick effectively
Dream's Ka has been disappointing lately so needs to show significant improvement from his recent runs
The going remains Good across all distances at Plumpton which should suit most of these runners

races.paceDynamic: Away For The Night will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, as only Pleasure Garden has the prominent style to potentially press the leader early. With Sea Thrift, Angel's Dream and Gold Souk all held up runners, the pace will be measured through the early stages before quickening from 3 out. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Away For The Night can dictate terms and kick clear when ready. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Away For The Night gets an uncontested lead and times his kick perfectly from 3 out.
scenarios.body: The measured early pace suits his stamina reserves and he can quicken clear before the hold-up horses get into gear. Pleasure Garden benefits from tracking the winner throughout and picks up the pieces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasure Garden presses Away For The Night early and creates a genuine pace duel.
scenarios.body: Both prominent runners compromise each other's finishing kicks, allowing the best of the hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong. Sea Thrift's class edge proves decisive in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the last fence.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace transforms this into a pure stamina test where the fresh finishers can unleash devastating late runs. Angel's Dream's recent Plumpton win gives him the course knowledge advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Away For The Night makes jumping errors under pressure and loses his rhythm.
scenarios.body: The front runner's mistakes create opportunities for all styles as the race fragments into a scramble. Gold Souk's 164-day break becomes an asset as his fresh legs carry him through the carnage.

watchPoints.text: Away For The Night's jumping under pressure - any mistakes will open the race up completely
Pleasure Garden's early positioning - whether he sits behind or challenges the leader changes everything
Sea Thrift and Angel's Dream getting clear runs from 2 out - small fields can still cause traffic jams
Gold Souk showing signs of fitness after his long break - market support would be significant
The pace through the first mile - if genuinely strong it transforms the finish completely

races.paceDynamic: Intellotto and General Briar will contest the early lead, with Intellotto's confirmed front-running style likely to dominate after General Briar's recent inconsistency. Six horses (Helnwein, Serious Challenge, Indemnity, Hamlet's Night, Aj's Diamond, Gentleman Joe) want prominent positions, creating congestion and forcing some back into midfield. The honest gallop from Intellotto will stretch the field, but the prominent pack will close strongly from the back of the last flight. This pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early traffic and deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Intellotto maintains a strong gallop and the prominent group gets crowded.
scenarios.body: The pace will be genuine enough to set up perfectly for the closers, while traffic problems will hinder those racing prominently. Hold-up specialists can pick their way through and time their challenges to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Helnwein or Serious Challenge can secure clean positions behind the leaders.
scenarios.body: These two class acts can track the pace without getting caught in the squeeze and have the tactical speed to strike before the hold-up horses arrive. Their superior ratings give them the edge in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Leader Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Intellotto gets an uncontested lead and the prominent group fails to organize.
scenarios.body: Without serious pressure, the leader can dictate a moderate tempo and have enough left to resist late challenges. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders stop quickly and the prominent horses also struggle.
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race where tactical positioning matters more than sustained pace, allowing midfield trackers to emerge late. The race becomes a sprint from the last flight where fresh legs matter most.

watchPoints.text: Intellotto must jump cleanly at the first flight as any mistake will hand the lead to unreliable General Briar and compromise the pace.
Helnwein and Serious Challenge risk getting trapped behind horses at the second-last as six prominent runners create inevitable congestion.
Inside Man's 150-day absence is a major concern despite his hold-up style suiting the likely pace scenario.
Fasol's tongue tie application suggests connections expect improved performance from this well-positioned hold-up horse.
Mondo Man's recent winning form makes him the most reliable hold-up option if the pace develops as anticipated.

races.paceDynamic: Inca De Lafayette will dictate terms from the front with no genuine pace pressure in this small field. Person Of Interest, Superstylin, and Sanitiser all hold prominent positions but none are confirmed pace forcers, creating a sustainable gallop throughout. The lack of early speed will produce a tactical affair with the real racing beginning after the final fence. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can control their own destiny, while penalising any hold-up horses who need a strong pace to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Inca Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Inca De Lafayette jumps fluently and maintains a steady rhythm from the front
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner dictates ideal fractions and has first run on his rivals after the last fence. His prominent style perfectly suits the lack of pace pressure and he can kick for home when ready.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Superstylin Times Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and Superstylin can improve his position approaching the final fence
scenarios.body: Tom Cannon can afford to be patient on the in-form nine-year-old and time his challenge perfectly. His recent winning form gives him the tactical edge in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sanitiser Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the Moore team produces another winner and Sanitiser can get competitive after his recent victories
scenarios.body: The improving seven-year-old has momentum from back-to-back wins and can capitalise if the leaders go too slowly. His prominent style allows him to stay in touch throughout the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Person Produces Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Person Of Interest overcomes his long absence and Paddy Hanlon gets the tactics right
scenarios.body: The six-year-old finds the sustained pace to his liking after 98 days off the track. His prominent style keeps him in contention but he needs everything to fall right after the layoff.

Inca De Lafayette must handle the responsibility of making all the running without getting headed too early
Superstylin's recent form gives him a clear fitness edge over most rivals in this tactical affair
The sustainable pace could produce a bunched finish where jumping the final fence cleanly becomes crucial
Sanitiser carries the confidence of consecutive wins but faces his biggest test yet in this company

races.paceDynamic: Eliza Dolittle will lead unchallenged from the start with her confirmed front-running style, setting a steady rhythm that suits her stamina-based profile over this extended 2m4½f trip. The prominent runners Market House and Washington Singer will track behind but neither has the early pace to pressure her, while the large contingent of hold-up horses (Rukaana, Path Of Stars, Ephyra, Ahellofaman, Smith) will settle towards the rear. This creates a race where the pace will be honest but not punishing early, before intensifying from the back of the last hurdle as the hold-up brigade unleash their finishing kicks. The tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained late rallies.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate and Eliza Dolittle maintains a steady gallop to the home turn
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up horses prove optimal as they have plenty left for a strong finish over the final 3-4 furlongs. Rukaana and Path Of Stars benefit most from this scenario with their proven ability to quicken late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Eliza Dolittle gets an easy lead and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late or get hampered
scenarios.body: Her stamina tells over this staying trip and she holds on grimly despite her moderate recent form. Washington Singer might emerge as the main threat tracking her throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Market House or Washington Singer decide to put pressure on Eliza Dolittle from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and favours those who can maintain a strong gallop rather than relying on a finishing kick. Market House's consistent placed efforts suggest he could benefit from forcing the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Eliza Dolittle goes too slow early and none of the prominent horses apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. This chaotic finish could suit an outsider like Smith who has shown ability in smaller fields.

watchPoints.text: Eliza Dolittle must be monitored early - if she goes too slowly the hold-up horses will have too much ammunition for the finish
Market House and Washington Singer's positioning behind the leader is crucial - they need to stay close enough to strike but not get drawn into early pace battle
Rukaana's jumping rhythm through the race given his recent busy schedule and hold-up style requirements
Path Of Stars needs to be produced with a clear run given his hold-up style and 51-day absence
The claiming jockeys on Eliza Dolittle and Ahellofaman may struggle with tactical decisions in a race where timing will be crucial
